    Questions

    Can we start under an NDA?

    Yes. Tick “request an NDA first” and keep confidential details out of the form. We send the NDA before we ask for any details.

    Which addresses will HAYKALAH contact me from?

    Only through haykalah.com and email addresses ending in @haykalah.com. If you are contacted in HAYKALAH’s name in any other way, check with us at haykalah@haykalah.com.

    What happens after I send a request?

    Your request goes to haykalah@haykalah.com, and a member of the team replies personally.

    Does HAYKALAH offer investments?

    No. Nothing on this website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice. Where a transaction involves an offer of securities, that activity is carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for the transaction.

    How is my information used?

    Only to reply to your request and, if you opt in, to send the Structuring Brief, as set out in the privacy notice under the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Analytics load only if you accept cookies.
